description_en: Creates and runs a Cloud Assistant command on one or more ECS instances. This operation supports Shell, PowerShell, and Bat scripts, and provides features such as scheduled execution, custom parameters, and execution within containers on the instances
description_zh: 本接口用于在一台或多台ECS实例中创建并执行云助手命令，支持Shell、PowerShell或者Bat类型的脚本，支持定时执行、自定义参数和实例内容器执行等功能
kebab_example: aliyun ecs run-command --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --type RunShellScript --command-content ZWNobyAxMjM= --region cn-hangzhou
name: RunCommand

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the command execution belongs. When you specify this parameter:

If the ECS instance specified by InstanceId belongs to a non-default resource group, the ECS instance must belong to this resource group.

You can specify this parameter to filter the corresponding command execution results by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/64840.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/64845.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
命令执行的资源组ID，当指定该参数时：

当InstanceId对应的ECS实例属于非默认资源组时，该ECS实例必须属于该资源组。

支持通过指定该参数筛选出对应的命令执行结果（通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/64840.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/64845.html）
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The command name. It supports all character sets and can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 命令名称。支持全字符集，长度不得超过128个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The command description. It supports all character sets and can be up to 512 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 命令描述。支持全字符集，长度不得超过512个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The command type. Valid values:

RunBatScript: Bat commands for Windows instances.
RunPowerShellScript: PowerShell commands for Windows instances.
RunShellScript: Shell commands for Linux instances
parameters.help_zh:
命令类型。取值范围：

RunBatScript：适用于Windows实例的Bat命令。
RunPowerShellScript：适用于Windows实例的PowerShell命令。
RunShellScript：适用于Linux实例的Shell命令
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The command content. The command content can be plaintext or Base64-encoded. Take note of the following items:

The size of the Base64-encoded command content cannot exceed 24 KB. You can use the `KeepCommand` parameter to specify whether to retain the command.
If the command content is Base64-encoded, you must set `ContentEncoding` to Base64.
If you set `EnableParameter` to true, you can use custom parameters in the command content:
    - Use `{{}}` to enclose custom parameters. Spaces and line breaks before and after the parameter names within `{{}}` are ignored.
    - You can define up to 20 custom parameters.
    - A custom parameter name can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_). The `acs::` prefix cannot be used to specify non-built-in environment variables. Other characters are not supported. Parameter names are not case-sensitive.
    - A single custom parameter name cannot exceed 64 bytes in length.

You can specify built-in environment variables as custom parameters. When the command is run, you do not need to manually assign values to the parameters. Cloud Assistant automatically replaces them with the corresponding values in the environment. The following built-in environment variables are supported:
    - `{{ACS::RegionId}}`: the region ID.
    - `{{ACS::AccountId}}`: the UID of the Alibaba Cloud account.
    - `{{ACS::InstanceId}}`: the instance ID. If the command is delivered to multiple instances and you want to specify `{{ACS::InstanceId}}` as a built-in environment variable, make sure that the Cloud Assistant Agent is of the following versions or later:
        - Linux: 2.2.3.309
        - Windows: 2.1.3.309
    - `{{ACS::InstanceName}}`: the instance name. If the command is delivered to multiple instances and you want to specify `{{ACS::InstanceName}}` as a built-in environment variable, make sure that the Cloud Assistant Agent is of the following versions or later:
        - Linux: 2.2.3.344
        - Windows: 2.1.3.344
    - `{{ACS::InvokeId}}`: the invocation ID. If you want to specify `{{ACS::InvokeId}}` as a built-in environment variable, make sure that the Cloud Assistant Agent is of the following versions or later:
        - Linux: 2.2.3.309
        - Windows: 2.1.3.309
    - `{{ACS::CommandId}}`: the command ID. If you call this operation to run a command and want to specify `{{ACS::CommandId}}` as a built-in environment variable, make sure that the Cloud Assistant Agent is of the following versions or later: 
        - Linux: 2.2.3.309
        - Windows: 2.1.3.309
parameters.help_zh:
命令内容。命令内容可以是明文内容或Base64编码后的内容。您需要注意：

命令内容在Base64编码后的大小不能超过24 KB。您可通过`KeepCommand`设置是否保留命令。
如果您的命令内容是Base64编码后的内容，则必须设置`ContentEncoding=Base64`。
指定参数`EnableParameter=true`可在命令内容中启用自定义参数功能：
    - 用`{{}}`包含的方式定义自定义参数，在`{{}}`内参数名前后的空格以及换行符会被忽略。
    - 自定义参数个数不能超过20个。
    - 自定义参数名允许a-zA-Z0-9-_的组合，不支持acs::前缀指定非内置环境参数，不支持其余字符，参数名不区分大小写。
    - 单个自定义参数名不能超过64字节。

您可以指定内置环境参数作为自定义参数，执行命令时无需手动对参数赋值，云助手将为您自动替换为环境中对应的值。支持指定以下内置环境参数：
    - `{{ACS::RegionId}}`：地域ID。
    - `{{ACS::AccountId}}`：阿里云主账号UID。
    - `{{ACS::InstanceId}}`：实例ID。命令下发到多个实例时，如需指定`{{ACS::InstanceId}}`作为内置环境参数，需确保云助手Agent不低于以下版本：
        - Linux：2.2.3.309
        - Windows：2.1.3.309
    - `{{ACS::InstanceName}}`：实例名称。命令下发到多个实例时，如需指定`{{ACS::InstanceName}}`作为内置环境参数，需确保云助手Agent不低于以下版本：
        - Linux：2.2.3.344
        - Windows：2.1.3.344
    - `{{ACS::InvokeId}}`：命令执行ID。如需指定`{{ACS::InvokeId}}`作为内置环境参数，需确保云助手Agent不低于以下版本：
        - Linux：2.2.3.309
        - Windows：2.1.3.309
    - `{{ACS::CommandId}}`：命令ID。通过调用本接口执行命令时，如需指定`{{ACS::CommandId}}`作为内置环境参数，需确保云助手Agent不低于以下版本： 
        - Linux：2.2.3.309
        - Windows：2.1.3.309
parameters.name: command_content

parameters.help_en:
The running directory of the command on the ECS instance. It can be up to 200 characters in length.

Default values:

For Linux instances, the default running directory is the home directory of the root user, which is `/root`.
For Windows instances, the default running directory is the directory where the Cloud Assistant Agent process resides, such as `C:\Windows\System32`
parameters.help_zh:
命令在ECS实例中的运行目录。长度不得超过200个字符。

默认值：

Linux系统实例默认在管理员（root用户）的home目录下，即`/root`。
Windows系统实例默认在云助手Agent进程所在目录，例如`C:\Windows\System32`
parameters.name: working_dir

parameters.help_en:
The timeout period for running the command. Unit: seconds.

If the command cannot be run because of process issues, missing modules, or a missing Cloud Assistant Agent, a timeout occurs. After a timeout, the command process is forcefully terminated.

Default value: 60
parameters.help_zh:
执行命令的超时时间，单位：秒。

当因为进程原因、缺失模块、缺失云助手Agent等原因无法运行命令时，会出现超时现象。超时后，会强制终止命令进程。

默认值：60
parameters.name: timeout

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the command contains custom parameters.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
命令中是否包含自定义参数。

默认值：false
parameters.name: enable_parameter

parameters.help_en:
The execution mode of the command. Valid values:

Once: runs the command immediately.
Period: runs the command on a schedule. If you set this parameter to `Period`, you must also specify the `Frequency` parameter.
NextRebootOnly: automatically runs the command the next time the instance starts.
EveryReboot: automatically runs the command every time the instance starts.
DryRun: prechecks the request only. The command is not actually run. The check items include the request parameters, instance execution environment, and Cloud Assistant Agent running status.

Default values:
If you do not specify the `Frequency` parameter, the default value is `Once`.
If you specify the `Frequency` parameter, the value is processed as `Period` regardless of whether this parameter is set.

Precautions:
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/64838.html operation to stop a pending command or a scheduled command.
If you set this parameter to `Period` or `EveryReboot`, you can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/64845.html operation and set `IncludeHistory` to true to view the historical records of the scheduled command execution
parameters.help_zh:
设置命令执行的方式。取值范围：

Once：立即执行命令。
Period：定时执行命令。当该参数取值为`Period`时，必须同时指定`Frequency`参数。
NextRebootOnly：当实例下一次启动时，自动执行命令。
EveryReboot：实例每一次启动都将自动执行命令。
DryRun：只预检此次请求，命令执行不会实际生效，检查项包括请求参数、实例执行环境、云助手Agent运行状态等。

默认值：
当不指定`Frequency`参数时，默认值为`Once`。
当指定`Frequency`参数时，无论是否已设置了该参数值，都将按照`Period`处理。

注意事项：
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/64838.html停止待执行的命令或定时执行的命令。
当该参数取值`Period`或者`EveryReboot`时，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/64845.html，然后指定8查看命令定时执行的历史记录
parameters.name: repeat_mode

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] This parameter is deprecated and does not take effect
parameters.help_zh: 该参数已废弃，传入该参数不会生效
parameters.name: timed

parameters.help_en:
The execution time of the scheduled command. Three scheduled execution modes are supported: execution at fixed time intervals (based on rate expressions), one-time execution at a specified time, and clock-based scheduled execution (based on cron expressions).

Execution at fixed time intervals: runs the command at the specified time interval based on a rate expression. The time interval can be specified in seconds (s), minutes (m), hours (h), or days (d). This mode is suitable for scenarios where tasks are run at fixed time intervals. The format is `rate(<interval value><interval unit>)`. For example, to run the command every 5 minutes, the format is `rate(5m)`. The following limits apply to execution at fixed time intervals:
    - The specified time interval must not exceed 7 days, must not be less than 60 seconds, and must be greater than the timeout period of the scheduled task.
    - The execution interval is based only on the fixed frequency and is independent of the actual time required to run the task. For example, if you set the command to run every 5 minutes and the task takes 2 minutes to complete, the next execution starts 3 minutes after the task is completed.
    - The task is not run immediately when it is created. For example, if you set the command to run every 5 minutes, the command is not run immediately when the task is created. Instead, it starts to run 5 minutes after the task is created.

One-time execution at a specified time: runs the command once at the specified time zone and execution time. The format is `at(yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss <time zone>)`, which is `at(year-month-day hour:minute:second <time zone>)`. If you do not specify a time zone, the UTC time zone is used by default. The time zone supports the following three formats:
    - Time zone full name: such as `Asia/Shanghai` (China/Shanghai time) and `America/Los_Angeles` (US/Los Angeles time).
    - Time zone offset from Greenwich Mean Time: such as `GMT+8:00` (East 8th time zone) and `GMT-7:00` (West 7th time zone). When you use the GMT format, leading zeros are not supported for the hour digit.
    - Time zone abbreviation: only UTC (Coordinated Universal Time) is supported.

  For example, to run the command once at 13:15:30 on June 6, 2022 in the China/Shanghai time zone, the format is `at(2022-06-06 13:15:30 Asia/Shanghai)`. To run the command once at 13:15:30 on June 6, 2022 in the West 7th time zone, the format is `at(2022-06-06 13:15:30 GMT-7:00)`.

Clock-based scheduled execution (based on cron expressions): runs the command based on a cron expression. The format is `<seconds> <minutes> <hours> <day of month> <month> <day of week> <year (optional)> <time zone>`, which is `<cron expression> <time zone>`. In the specified time zone, the scheduled task execution time is calculated based on the cron expression and the task is run. If you do not specify a time zone, the internal system time zone of the instance that runs the scheduled task is used by default. For more information about cron expressions, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/64769.html. The time zone supports the following three formats:
    - Time zone full name: such as `Asia/Shanghai` (China/Shanghai time) and `America/Los_Angeles` (US/Los Angeles time).
    - Time zone offset from Greenwich Mean Time: such as `GMT+8:00` (East 8th time zone) and `GMT-7:00` (West 7th time zone). When you use the GMT format, leading zeros are not supported for the hour digit.
    - Time zone abbreviation: only UTC (Coordinated Universal Time) is supported.
  For example, to run the command once at 10:15 every day in 2022 in the China/Shanghai time zone, the format is `0 15 10 ? * * 2022 Asia/Shanghai`. To run the command every half hour from 10:00 to 11:30 every day in 2022 in the East 8th time zone, the format is `0 0/30 10-11 * * ? 2022 GMT+8:00`. To run the command every 5 minutes from 14:00 to 14:55 every day in October every two years starting from 2022 in the UTC time zone, the format is `0 0/5 14 * 10 ? 2022/2 UTC`.

    > The minimum time interval must be greater than or equal to the timeout period of the scheduled task and must not be less than 10 seconds
parameters.help_zh:
定时执行命令的执行时间。目前支持三种定时执行方式：固定时间间隔执行（基于Rate表达式）、仅在指定时间执行一次、基于时钟定时执行（基于Cron表达式）。

固定时间间隔执行：基于Rate表达式，按照设置的时间间隔执行命令。时间间隔支持按秒（s） 、分钟（m） 、小时（h）和天（d）来选择，适用于在固定时间间隔执行任务的场景。格式为`rate(<执行间隔数值><执行间隔单位>)`，如5分钟执行一次，格式为`rate(5m)`。使用固定时间间隔执行有以下限制：
    - 设置的时间间隔不大于7天、不小于60秒，且需大于定时任务的超时时间。
    - 执行间隔只基于固定频率，与任务实际执行需要的时间无关。例如设置每5分钟执行一次命令，任务需要2分钟执行完成，则在任务完成3分钟后继续执行下一轮。
    - 创建任务时不会立即执行。例如设置每5分钟执行一次命令，创建任务时不会立即执行一次命令，而是在任务创建完成后的5分钟后开始执行。

仅在指定时间执行一次：按照设置的时区和执行时间点执行一次命令。格式为`at(yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss <时区>)`，即`at(年-月-日 时:分:秒 <时区>)`。如果不指定时区，默认为UTC时区。时区支持以下三种形式：
    - 时区全称：  如`Asia/Shanghai`（中国/上海时间）、`America/Los_Angeles`（美国/洛杉矶时间）等。
    - 时区相对于格林威治时间的偏移量：  如`GMT+8:00`（东八区）、`GMT-7:00`（西七区）等。使用GMT格式时，小时位不支持添加前导零。
    - 时区缩写：  仅支持UTC（协调世界时间）。

  如果指定在中国/上海时间2022年06月06日13时15分30秒执行一次，格式为：`at(2022-06-06 13:15:30 Asia/Shanghai)`；如果指定在西七区2022年06月06日13时15分30秒执行一次，格式为：`at(2022-06-06 13:15:30 GMT-7:00)`。

基于时钟定时执行（基于Cron表达式）：基于Cron表达式，按照设置的定时任务执行命令。格式为`<秒> <分钟> <小时> <日期> <月份> <星期> <年份（可选）> <时区>`，即`<Cron表达式> <时区>`。在指定的时区下，根据Cron表达式推算定时任务执行时间并执行。若不指定时区，默认为执行定时任务实例的系统内部时区。关于Cron表达式的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/64769.html。时区支持以下三种形式：
    - 时区全称：  如`Asia/Shanghai`（中国/上海时间）、`America/Los_Angeles`（美国/洛杉矶时间）等。
    - 时区相对于格林威治时间的偏移量：  如`GMT+8:00`（东八区）、`GMT-7:00`（西七区）等。使用GMT格式时，小时位不支持添加前导零。
    - 时区缩写：  仅支持UTC（协调世界时间）。
  例如，在中国/上海时间，2022年每天上午10:15执行一次命令，格式为`0 15 10 ? * * 2022 Asia/Shanghai`；在东八区时间，2022年每天上午10:00到11:30每隔半小时执行，格式为`0 0/30 10-11 * * ? 2022 GMT+8:00`；在UTC时间，从2022年开始，每隔两年的10月每天下午14:00到下午14:55时间段内每隔5分钟执行，格式为`0 0/5 14 * 10 ? 2022/2 UTC`。

    >设置的最小时间间隔需大于或等于定时任务的超时时间，且不小于10 秒
parameters.name: frequency

parameters.help_en:
The key-value pairs of custom parameters that are passed in when the command is run, if the command contains custom parameters. For example, if the command content is `echo {{name}}`, you can pass in the key-value pair `{"name":"Jack"}` by using the `Parameter` parameter. The custom parameter automatically replaces the variable value `name`, and a new command is generated. The actual command that is run is `echo Jack`.

The number of custom parameters ranges from 0 to 10. Take note of the following items:

The key cannot be an empty string and can be up to 64 characters in length.
The value can be an empty string.
After the custom parameters and the original command content are Base64-encoded, the size of the Base64-encoded command content cannot exceed 24 KB. You can use the `KeepCommand` parameter to specify whether to retain the command.
The set of custom parameter names must be a subset of the parameter set defined when the command is created. For parameters that are not passed in, you can use empty strings instead.

The default value is empty, which indicates that this parameter is not set and the custom parameter feature is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
命令中包含自定义参数时，执行命令时传入的自定义参数的键值对。例如，命令内容为`echo {{name}}`，则可以通过`Parameter`参数传入键值对`{"name":"Jack"}`。自定义参数将自动替换变量值`name`，得到一条新的命令，实际执行的是`echo Jack`。

自定义参数的个数范围为0~10，且您需要注意：

键不允许为空字符串，最多支持64个字符。
值允许为空字符串。
自定义参数与原始命令内容在Base64编码后，命令内容在Base64编码后的大小不能超过24 KB。您可通过`KeepCommand`设置是否保留命令。
设置的自定义参数名集合必须为创建命令时定义的参数集的子集。对于未传入的参数，您可以使用空字符串代替。

默认值为空，表示取消设置该参数从而禁用自定义参数
parameters.name: parameters

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to retain the command after it is run. Valid values:

true: retains the command. You can call the InvokeCommand operation to run the command again. This consumes the quota for retained Cloud Assistant commands.
false: does not retain the command. The command is automatically deleted after it is run and does not consume the quota for retained Cloud Assistant commands.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
执行完该命令后，是否保留下来。取值范围：

true：保留。可以通过InvokeCommand再次执行。会占用云助手命令的保有量配额。
false：不保留。执行完成后自动删除，不占用云助手命令的保有量配额。

默认值：false
parameters.name: keep_command

parameters.help_en:
The encoding mode of the command content (`CommandContent`). Valid values (case-insensitive):

PlainText: no encoding. The command content is transmitted in plaintext.
Base64: Base64 encoding.

Default value: PlainText. If you enter an invalid value, it is processed as PlainText
parameters.help_zh:
命令内容（`CommandContent`）的编码方式。取值范围（不区分大小写）：

PlainText：不编码，采用明文传输。
Base64：Base64编码。

默认值：PlainText，乱填或错填该取值会当作PlainText处理
parameters.name: content_encoding

parameters.help_en:
The username that is used to run the command on the ECS instance. It can be up to 255 characters in length.

For Linux ECS instances, the command is run by the root user by default.
For Windows ECS instances, the command is run by the System user by default.

You can also specify another existing user on the instance to run the command. Running Cloud Assistant commands as a regular user is more secure. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/203771.html
parameters.help_zh:
在ECS实例中执行命令的用户名称。长度不得超过255个字符。

Linux系统的ECS实例，默认以root用户执行命令。
Windows系统的ECS实例，默认以System用户执行命令。

您也可以指定实例中已存在的其他用户执行命令，以普通用户执行云助手命令更加安全。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/203771.html
parameters.name: username

parameters.help_en:
The password name of the user that is used to execute the command on the Windows instance. It can be up to 255 characters in length.

If you want to execute the command as a non-default user (System) on a Windows instance, you must specify both `Username` and this parameter. To reduce the risk of password leakage, you must host the plaintext password in the parameter repository of CloudOps Orchestration Service and pass in only the password name here. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186828.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/203771.html.

You do not need to pass in this parameter when you execute the command as the root user on a Linux instance or the System user on a Windows instance
parameters.help_zh:
在Windows实例中执行命令的用户的密码名称。长度不得超过255个字符。

当您希望以非默认用户（System）在Windows实例中执行命令时，需要同时传入`Username`和该参数。为降低密码泄露的风险，需要将密码明文托管在系统运维管理的参数仓库中，此处仅传入密码的名称。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186828.html以及https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/203771.html。

当您使用Linux实例的root用户或Windows实例的System用户执行命令时，不需要传递该参数
parameters.name: windows_password_name

parameters.help_en:
The array of ECS instance IDs. Array length: 1 to 100.

If you specify multiple instances and one of the instances does not meet the execution conditions, you must reselect the instances.

You can also apply for a quota increase in Quota Center. The quota name is the maximum number of instances that support command execution
parameters.help_zh:
ECS实例ID数组，数组长度：1~100。

若指定了多台实例后，其中某台实例不满足执行条件时，您需要重新选择。

您也可以在配额中心申请提升配额（配额名称为命令执行支持实例上限数）
parameters.name: instance_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the command to execute. It cannot be an empty string once specified.

If you use a single tag to filter resources, the resource count under the tag cannot exceed 1,000. If you use multiple tags to filter resources, the resource count of resources that are attached to all the specified tags cannot exceed 1,000. If the resource count exceeds 1,000, you must use the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/110425.html operation to query the resources.

It can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
命令执行的标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

使用一个标签过滤资源，查询到该标签下的资源数量不能超过1000个。使用多个标签过滤资源，查询到同时绑定了多个标签的资源数量不能超过1000个。如果资源数量超过1000个，您需要使用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/110425.html接口进行查询。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`

fields.help_en:

fields.help_zh:

最多支持128个字符，不能包含`http://`或`https://`

parameters.help_en:
The container ID. Only 64-bit hexadecimal strings are supported. The `docker://`, `containerd://`, or `cri-o://` prefix is allowed to explicitly specify the container runtime.

Precautions:
If you specify this parameter, Cloud Assistant runs the script in the specified container on the instance.
If you specify this parameter, it is only supported on Linux instances where the Cloud Assistant Agent version is 2.2.3.344 or later.
If you specify this parameter, the specified `Username` and `WorkingDir` parameters do not take effect. The command can only be run by the default user of the container in the default working directory of the container. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/456641.html.
Only Shell scripts can be run in Linux containers. You cannot use a command similar to `#!/usr/bin/python` at the beginning of the script to specify the interpreter for the script content. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/456641.html
parameters.help_zh:
容器ID。仅支持64位16进制字符串，允许存在`docker://`、`containerd://`或者`cri-o://`前缀来明确指定的容器运行。

注意事项：
如果指定了该参数，云助手将在实例的指定容器内执行脚本。
如果指定了该参数，仅支持在云助手Agent版本不低于2.2.3.344的Linux实例内运行。
如果指定了该参数，已指定的`Username`参数和`WorkingDir`参数将不会生效。仅支持通过容器默认用户在容器的默认工作目录下执行命令。详细信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/456641.html。
在Linux容器中只支持执行Shell脚本，不支持在脚本开头使用类似`#!/usr/bin/python`命令的形式指定脚本内容的解释器。详细信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/456641.html

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that it is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html

parameters.help_en:
The OSS delivery configuration for the command execution output.

Format: oss://${BucketName}/${Prefix}. ${BucketName} is the name of the OSS bucket to which the output is delivered, and ${Prefix} is the directory prefix to which the output is delivered
parameters.help_zh:
命令执行Output OSS投递配置。

格式：oss://${BucketName}/${Prefix}，${BucketName}为待投递到的OSS Bucket名称，${Prefix}为待投递到的目录前缀
parameters.name: oss_output_delivery

fields.help_en:
The tag key used to filter instances.

Precautions:

This parameter conflicts with the InstanceId parameter and they cannot be specified at the same time.

It cannot be an empty string once specified.

The number of instances under the tag cannot exceed the limit on the number of InstanceId.N parameters. If the number of instances exceeds the limit, we recommend that you control the number of instances by adding batch tags, such as batch: b1.

It can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. It cannot contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh:
用于筛选实例的标签键。

注意事项：

与参数InstanceId冲突，不能同时指定。

一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

标签下的实例数量不能超过InstanceId.N的数量限制；如果实例数量超出限制，建议通过添加批次标签等方式控制实例数量，例如batch: b1。

最多支持64个字符，不能以aliyun或acs:开头，不能包含http://或https://

parameters.help_en:
The mode used when the task is stopped (manually stopped or interrupted due to execution timeout). Valid values:
Process: stops the current script process.
ProcessTree: stops the current process tree (the set of the script process and all child processes created by it)
parameters.help_zh:
停止任务（手动停止或执行超时打断）时的模式。可能值：
Process：停止当前脚本进程。
ProcessTree：停止当前进程树（脚本进程以及它创建的所有子进程的集合）
parameters.name: termination_mode
